name: spark-alight-refuses-spellshroud-unit-damages-ordinary-ally
notes: Spark Alight: of the opposing Genbu (spellshroud) and an ordinary ally only the ordinary ally is selectable. Pre-fix Genbu was offered too.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 unpreventable damage to target unit.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Spark Alight's generated opening body (like ~35 other Spell openers) built its target list without FilterSpellshroudTargets(), so an ally with spellshroud (e.g. Genbu, Black Tortoise) was offered and could be targeted by the Spell. Rather than override each generated closure, OnCardActivated() (Custom/GameLogic.php) now filters the explicit-target choices (MZCHOOSE / MZMAYCHOOSE over field objects) that ANY Spell's opener queues through GASpellshroudFilterNewDecisions(): spellshroud objects are removed, and a choice left with no legal target is dropped with its continuation so the Spell fizzles.
